topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text:
Driveway's supposed to be the safe spot, the one place where you can park and not have to worry about the vultures. But this ain't no ordinary night. Rain's been lashing down like it's trying to wash away more than just the dirt. I pull up, and there it is—or rather, there it isn't. The car. Gone without a trace, or so it seems. A tow truck's footprint in the wet gravel, maybe a note if you're lucky. But what I find is a piece of paper, flapping like a lost bird in the wind. Says it all, doesn't it? Rules, fines, the dance of the dollar. I seen it all before, but this—this is a new step in the tango.禛
Note: I adjusted the text to better fit the hardboiled detective style and to more subtly convey the feeling of surprise without naming it.
